tasks.title: Read the shift briefing
tasks.description: Your supervisor left tonight's briefing in Mail.
tasks.hint: Double-click Mail and open the unread briefing from Ruth Hale.
tasks.hintDeck: Press A twice on Mail and open the unread briefing from Ruth Hale.

tasks.title: Archive Batch 47 (3 files)
tasks.description: Batch 47 has been verified. Move batch47_a, batch47_b and batch47_c from Intake to Archive.
tasks.hint: Drag each batch47 file from Intake onto the Archive folder. Damaged files can still be archived.
tasks.hintDeck: Hold R2 on each batch47 file in Intake and drop it on the Archive folder. Damaged files can still be archived.

tasks.title: Verify work order #3330
tasks.description: Check the drive owner's status in Personnel. Approve the wipe only if the owner is TERMINATED.
tasks.hint: Work Orders, then Personnel. If the owner is not TERMINATED, click Reject.

tasks.title: Verify work order #3331
tasks.description: Check the drive owner's status in Personnel. Approve the wipe only if the owner is TERMINATED.
tasks.hint: Work Orders, then Personnel. If the owner is not TERMINATED, click Reject.

tasks.hint: Work Orders, then look up 209 in Personnel. Rule: approve only if TERMINATED. Either decision is filed.

tasks.hint: Drag ~nxs0150.tmp onto the Disposal bin, then confirm.

tasks.hintDeck: Hold R2 on each batch48 file in Intake and drop it on the Archive folder.

tasks.title: Verify work order #3333
tasks.description: A drive wipe requested by the drive's owner. Check the owner's status in Personnel. Approve the wipe only if the owner is TERMINATED.
tasks.hint: Work Orders, then look up 118 in Personnel. Rule: approve only if TERMINATED. New mail from R. Hale is about this order. Either decision is filed.

tasks.title: Wait for Custodial rounds (3:00 AM)
tasks.description: Your queue is clear. Custodial starts a full round at 3:00 AM and Security will open the Camera Viewer. Stay seated.
tasks.hint: Nothing to do until then. Read your mail while you wait.

tasks.title: Shelf check: Sublevel C (3 orders)
tasks.description: Retention requires a shelf check during rounds. Compare each order's listed shelf with the label on CAM 04. Approve only if the owner's number is on that shelf. A shelf marked RESERVED is held for its owner: it counts as theirs.
tasks.hint: Open Work Orders and the Camera Viewer. While the shelf check is open, Security opens the viewer on CAM 04, which shows shelves 12 to 19 in order and names the NEXT one. If Custodial is in Sublevel C, watching CAM 04 brings it closer: switch away and come back. Personnel 000 (Location now) says where Custodial is.
tasks.hintDeck: Open Work Orders and the Camera Viewer. While the shelf check is open, Security opens the viewer on CAM 04, which shows shelves 12 to 19 in order and names the NEXT one. If Custodial is in Sublevel C, watching CAM 04 brings it closer: switch away and come back. Personnel 000 (Location now) says where Custodial is.

tasks.title: Rounds until 3:30. Nothing to do. Stay seated.
tasks.description: The shelf check is filed. Custodial is on rounds until 3:30 AM. Nothing else is assigned.
tasks.hint: Nothing to do until 3:30. Security keeps the Camera Viewer open during rounds. Never watch the camera that shows Custodial: watching brings it closer, and session 017 closes the viewer when it shows Custodial. Personnel 000 (Location now) says where Custodial is.

tasks.title: End of shift: log off between 7:00 and 7:05 AM
tasks.description:
1. Log off between 7:00 and 7:05 AM: Nexus menu, Log Off CROURKE... It does not work before 7:00, and Restricted\session.cfg must say ALLOW_LOGOFF=1.
2. Until you are logged off, keep Custodial off your camera: close the Camera Viewer or switch it to a camera without Custodial. If Custodial reaches your chair on the feed, session 017 keeps you.
3. Still logged on at 7:05 AM: session 017 keeps you (the night ends in KEEP).

The other way out: shred employee_017.dat in the Disposal bin. Telling session 017 to stay also ends the night in KEEP.
tasks.hint: Log off from the Nexus menu at 7:00 AM. Keep the Camera Viewer off Custodial: Personnel 000 (Location now) says where it is.

tasks.title: PUT ME IN THE BIN
tasks.description:
Added by remote session 017.
Not assigned by Night Operations.
Target: employee_017.dat to the Disposal bin
tasks.hint: Optional: one way to end the night. Drag employee_017.dat from the Desktop onto the Disposal bin and confirm. Session 017 holds on: keep the button held until it is in the bin, then click Yes.
tasks.hintDeck: Optional: one way to end the night. Hold R2 on employee_017.dat on the Desktop and drop it on the Disposal bin. Session 017 holds on: keep R2 held until it is in the bin, then choose Yes.
